description: Pantauan kesehatan server, service, RAM, storage, dan proses abnormal LRT Jabodebek.

panels.title: Server DOWN
panels.description: Target di nodes/windows yang tidak merespons. Jika agent belum terpasang, keluarkan dengan prune-down-targets.py.

targets.expr: avg((100 - (100 * node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|devtmpfs", mountpoint=~"/|/data|/home", server_id=~"$server"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|devtmpfs", mountpoint=~"/|/data|/home", server_id=~"$server"})) or (100 - (100 * windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{volume=~"[A-Z]:", server_id=~"$server"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{volume=~"[A-Z]:", server_id=~"$server"})))
count(max by (server_id, name, instance) (lrt_service_expected{server_id=~"$server"} == 1 and on(server_id, name, instance) lrt_service_up{server_id=~"$server"} == 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Service DOWN
panels.description: Jumlah service pantauan yang mati. Saat service UP lagi, angka turun dan alert hilang otomatis.

targets.expr: max by (instance, server_id, application, lokasi) ((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{server_id=~"$server"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{server_id=~"$server"})) or (100 * (1 - windows_memory_available_bytes{server_id=~"$server"} / windows_cs_physical_memory_bytes{server_id=~"$server"})))

max by (instance, server_id, application, lokasi) ((100 * (1 - avg by (instance, server_id, application, lokasi) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", server_id=~"$server"}[5m])))) or (100 * (1 - avg by (instance, server_id, application, lokasi) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle", server_id=~"$server"}[5m])))))

max by (instance, server_id, application, lokasi) ((100 - (100 * node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|devtmpfs", mountpoint="/", server_id=~"$server"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|devtmpfs", mountpoint="/", server_id=~"$server"})) or (100 - (100 * windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{volume="C:", server_id=~"$server"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{volume="C:", server_id=~"$server"})))

panels.title: Ringkasan kesehatan per server (hanya UP)
panels.description: Hanya server yang merespons (UP). Server tanpa agent jangan didaftarkan di nodes.yml.
Server yang ada di target scrape tetapi tidak merespons (up==0). Jika agent belum dipasang, keluarkan dari nodes.yml dengan bash scripts/cleanup-false-down.sh --apply
panels.title: Daftar server DOWN

panels.description: Semua service yang dipantau. Hijau=UP, merah=DOWN. Alert ServiceTidakAktif muncul saat DOWN dan hilang saat UP kembali.

targets.expr: max by (server_id, name, application, lokasi, instance) (lrt_service_up{server_id=~"$server"})

panels.title: Status service pantauan (UP/DOWN)

panels.description: Hanya service yang sedang DOWN. Baris hilang otomatis saat service UP lagi.

targets.expr: max by (server_id, name, application, lokasi, instance) (lrt_service_expected{server_id=~"$server"} == 1 and on(server_id, name, instance) lrt_service_up{server_id=~"$server"} == 0)

panels.title: Service DOWN saja

targets.expr: max by (server_id, name, application, lokasi, instance) (lrt_service_expected{server_id=~"$server"} == 1 and on(server_id, name, instance) lrt_service_up{server_id=~"$server"} == 0)

panels.title: Service DOWN (systemd detail)
panels.description: Service expected (dari agent) yang sudah tidak aktif. Daftar expected sticky, diisi otomatis setiap 5 menit.

panels.title: Notifikasi abnormal (alert aktif)
panels.description: Alert FIRING saat masalah terjadi. Saat pulih, status menjadi RESOLVED dan baris hilang dari tabel ini. ServiceTidakAktif: mati→alert, UP lagi→hilang.

list.description: Regex unit systemd yang dipantau. Default __none__ = belum dikonfigurasi. Contoh: nginx.service|postgresql.service
list.label: Service pantauan
list.name: service_unit
